changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwdocumentdefinition AS SELECT dd.id, dd.code, dd.name, dd.description, dd.category, dd.status, dd.created_by, dd.created_date, dd.last_modified_by, dd.last_modified_date FROM public.document_definition dd;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwdocumentdefinition TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwdocumentdefinition FROM report_user;
